title: Firebase Cloud Messaging
ported_from: a production push adapter (batched multicast, per-token outcome mapping), generalized
usage:
const messaging = createFirebaseMessaging(JSON.parse(serviceAccountJson));
createNotifications({ environment: 'prod', push: { provider: 'custom' }, pushSender: new FcmPushSender({ messaging: messaging.messaging }) });
notes: Keys only: the consumer reads the service-account file named by the first key and passes the parsed object to createFirebaseMessaging; it is never stored in this package.
